scenes.heading: Responsibilities of a Data Engineer
scenes.subheading: The day-to-day work behind reliable data
scenes.narration: A data engineer's job spans building pipelines, modeling data, and keeping the whole system dependable.

scenes.heading: Core responsibilities
scenes.narration: Engineers build and maintain pipelines because data must flow continuously and correctly. They design storage and models so that data can be queried efficiently. They guard data quality because bad data leads to bad decisions. They monitor systems so failures are caught early rather than by surprise. And they collaborate closely with analysts and scientists who depend on their output.

scenes.heading: A typical pipeline lifecycle
scenes.narration: The engineer ingests data from many sources and validates it against expectations. They then transform and model it into clean tables and load those into the warehouse. Throughout, they monitor the pipeline and set up alerts so problems surface immediately.

scenes.text: A data engineer's core mission is delivering data that is available, accurate, and trustworthy at scale.
scenes.narration: At its heart, the role is about delivering data that is available, accurate, and trustworthy, so the rest of the organization can rely on it.
